entities.name: Miloslav Ištvan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miloslav Ištvan was a Czech composer. His work was inspired by the works of Béla Bartók and by the orientation of the modal style of folk songs. He studied Romanian and African folklore. He also attempted a synthesis of classical and pop music genres.

entities.summary: Miloslav Ištvan was a Czech composer. His work was inspired by the works of Béla Bartók and by the orientation of the modal style of folk songs. He studied Romanian and African folklore. He also attempted a synthesis of classical and pop music genres.
